folded.object: Our signs and a clear authority

spans.text: [23] AR: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا مُوسَىٰ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا وَسُلْطَٰنٍۢ مُّبِينٍ EN: And We did certainly send Moses with Our signs and a clear authority

[3] AR: غَافِرِ ٱلذَّنۢبِ وَقَابِلِ ٱلتَّوْبِ شَدِيدِ ٱلْعِقَابِ ذِى ٱلطَّوْلِ ۖ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ۖ إِلَيْهِ ٱلْمَصِيرُ EN: The forgiver of sin, acceptor of repentance, severe in punishment, owner of abundance.
So I seized them, and how [terrible] was My penalty.

folded.id: so|is|there to an exit any way?"
folded.subject: So
folded.object: there to an exit any way?"

spans.text: So is there to an exit any way?"

folded.id: than them|in|strength and in impression on the land
folded.subject: than them
folded.object: strength and in impression on the land

spans.text: They were greater than them in strength and in impression on the land, but Allah seized them for their sins.

[12] AR: ذَٰلِكُم بِأَنَّهُۥٓ إِذَا دُعِىَ ٱللَّهُ وَحْدَهُۥ كَفَرْتُمْ ۖ وَإِن يُشْرَكْ بِهِۦ تُؤْمِنُوا۟ ۚ فَٱلْحُكْمُ لِلَّهِ ٱلْعَلِىِّ ٱلْكَبِيرِ EN: [They will be told], "That is because, when Allah was called upon alone, you disbelieved; but if others were associated with Him, you believed.

folded.id: that|was|because their messengers were coming to them with clear proofs
folded.subject: That
folded.object: because their messengers were coming to them with clear proofs

spans.text: [22] AR: ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمْ كَانَت تَّأْتِيهِمْ رُسُلُهُم بِٱلْبَيِّنَٰتِ فَكَفَرُوا۟ فَأَخَذَهُمُ ٱللَّهُ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ قَوِىٌّۭ شَدِيدُ ٱلْعِقَابِ EN: That was because their messengers were coming to them with clear proofs, but they disbelieved, so Allah seized them.

folded.id: the day|they|come forth nothing concerning them will be concealed from allah
folded.subject: The Day
folded.object: come forth nothing concerning them will be concealed from Allah

spans.text: [16] AR: يَوْمَ هُم بَٰرِزُونَ ۖ لَا يَخْفَىٰ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ مِنْهُمْ شَىْءٌۭ ۚ لِّمَنِ ٱلْمُلْكُ ٱلْيَوْمَ ۖ لِلَّهِ ٱلْوَٰحِدِ ٱلْقَهَّارِ EN: The Day they come forth nothing concerning them will be concealed from Allah.

[15] AR: رَفِيعُ ٱلدَّرَجَٰتِ ذُو ٱلْعَرْشِ يُلْقِى ٱلرُّوحَ مِنْ أَمْرِهِۦ عَلَىٰ مَن يَشَآءُ مِنْ عِبَادِهِۦ لِيُنذِرَ يَوْمَ ٱلتَّلَاقِ EN: [He is] the Exalted above [all] degrees, Owner of the Throne; He places the inspiration of His command upon whom He wills of His servants to warn of the Day of Meeting.
[2] AR: تَنزِيلُ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْعَلِيمِ EN: The revelation of the Book is from Allah, the Exalted in Might, the Knowing.
[19] AR: يَعْلَمُ خَآئِنَةَ ٱلْأَعْيُنِ وَمَا تُخْفِى ٱلصُّدُورُ EN: He knows that which deceives the eyes and what the breasts conceal.

[3] AR: غَافِرِ ٱلذَّنۢبِ وَقَابِلِ ٱلتَّوْبِ شَدِيدِ ٱلْعِقَابِ ذِى ٱلطَّوْلِ ۖ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ۖ إِلَيْهِ ٱلْمَصِيرُ EN: The forgiver of sin, acceptor of repentance, severe in punishment, owner of abundance.

folded.id: the hatred|of|allah for you was [even] greater than your hatred of yourselves [this day in hell] when you were invited to faith
folded.subject: The hatred
folded.object: Allah for you was [even] greater than your hatred of yourselves [this Day in Hell] when you were invited to faith

spans.text: [10] AR: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ يُنَادَوْنَ لَمَقْتُ ٱللَّهِ أَكْبَرُ مِن مَّقْتِكُمْ أَنفُسَكُمْ إِذْ تُدْعَوْنَ إِلَى ٱلْإِيمَٰنِ فَتَكْفُرُونَ EN: Indeed, those who disbelieve will be addressed, "The hatred of Allah for you was [even] greater than your hatred of yourselves [this Day in Hell] when you were invited to faith, but you refused."

folded.id: the inspiration|of|his command upon whom he wills of his servants to warn of the day of meeting
folded.subject: the inspiration
folded.object: His command upon whom He wills of His servants to warn of the Day of Meeting

spans.text: [15] AR: رَفِيعُ ٱلدَّرَجَٰتِ ذُو ٱلْعَرْشِ يُلْقِى ٱلرُّوحَ مِنْ أَمْرِهِۦ عَلَىٰ مَن يَشَآءُ مِنْ عِبَادِهِۦ لِيُنذِرَ يَوْمَ ٱلتَّلَاقِ EN: [He is] the Exalted above [all] degrees, Owner of the Throne; He places the inspiration of His command upon whom He wills of His servants to warn of the Day of Meeting.
So the judgement is with Allah, the Most High, the Grand."

folded.id: the people|of|noah denied before them and the [disbelieving] factions after them
folded.subject: The people
folded.object: Noah denied before them and the [disbelieving] factions after them

spans.text: [5] AR: كَذَّبَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍۢ وَٱلْأَحْزَابُ مِنۢ بَعْدِهِمْ ۖ وَهَمَّتْ كُلُّ أُمَّةٍۭ بِرَسُولِهِمْ لِيَأْخُذُوهُ ۖ وَجَٰدَلُوا۟ بِٱلْبَٰطِلِ لِيُدْحِضُوا۟ بِهِ ٱلْحَقَّ فَأَخَذْتُهُمْ ۖ فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عِقَابِ EN: The people of Noah denied before them and the [disbelieving] factions after them, and every nation intended [a plot] for their messenger to seize him, and they disputed by [using] falsehood to [attempt to] invalidate thereby the truth.

folded.id: the plan|of|the disbelievers is not except in error
folded.subject: the plan
folded.object: the disbelievers is not except in error

spans.text: But the plan of the disbelievers is not except in error.

folded.id: the revelation|of|the book is from allah
folded.subject: The revelation

spans.text: [2] AR: تَنزِيلُ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْعَلِيمِ EN: The revelation of the Book is from Allah, the Exalted in Might, the Knowing.

folded.id: the signs|of|allah except those who disbelieve
folded.subject: the signs

spans.text: [4] AR: مَا يُجَٰدِلُ فِىٓ ءَايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ فَلَا يَغْرُرْكَ تَقَلُّبُهُمْ فِى ٱلْبِلَٰدِ EN: No one disputes concerning the signs of Allah except those who disbelieve, so be not deceived by their [uninhibited] movement throughout the land.

folded.id: the sons|of|those who have believed with him and keep their women alive
folded.subject: the sons
folded.object: those who have believed with him and keep their women alive

spans.text: [25] AR: فَلَمَّا جَآءَهُم بِٱلْحَقِّ مِنْ عِندِنَا قَالُوا۟ ٱقْتُلُوٓا۟ أَبْنَآءَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مَعَهُۥ وَٱسْتَحْيُوا۟ نِسَآءَهُمْ ۚ وَمَا كَيْدُ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ إِلَّا فِى ضَلَٰلٍۢ EN: And when he brought them the truth from Us, they said, "Kill the sons of those who have believed with him and keep their women alive."

folded.id: the throne|and|those around it exalt [allah] with praise of their lord and believe in him and ask forgiveness for those who have believed
folded.subject: the Throne
folded.object: those around it exalt [Allah] with praise of their Lord and believe in Him and ask forgiveness for those who have believed

spans.text: [7] AR: ٱلَّذِينَ يَحْمِلُونَ ٱلْعَرْشَ وَمَنْ حَوْلَهُۥ يُسَبِّحُونَ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّهِمْ وَيُؤْمِنُونَ بِهِۦ وَيَسْتَغْفِرُونَ لِلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ رَبَّنَا وَسِعْتَ كُلَّ شَىْءٍۢ رَّحْمَةًۭ وَعِلْمًۭا فَٱغْفِرْ لِلَّذِينَ تَابُوا۟ وَٱتَّبَعُوا۟ سَبِيلَكَ وَقِهِمْ عَذَابَ ٱلْجَحِيمِ EN: Those [angels] who carry the Throne and those around it exalt [Allah] with praise of their Lord and believe in Him and ask forgiveness for those who have believed, [saying], "Our Lord, You have encompassed all things in mercy and knowledge, so forgive those who have repented and followed Your way and protect them from the punishment of Hellfire.

folded.id: the word|of|your lord come into effect upon those who disbelieved that they are companions of the fire
folded.subject: the word
folded.object: your Lord come into effect upon those who disbelieved that they are companions of the Fire

spans.text: [6] AR: وَكَذَٰلِكَ حَقَّتْ كَلِمَتُ رَبِّكَ عَلَى ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓا۟ أَنَّهُمْ أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلنَّارِ EN: And thus has the word of your Lord come into effect upon those who disbelieved that they are companions of the Fire.

[8] AR: رَبَّنَا وَأَدْخِلْهُمْ جَنَّٰتِ عَدْنٍ ٱلَّتِى وَعَدتَّهُمْ وَمَن صَلَحَ مِنْ ءَابَآئِهِمْ وَأَزْوَٰجِهِمْ وَذُرِّيَّٰتِهِمْ ۚ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ EN: Our Lord, and admit them to gardens of perpetual residence which You have promised them and whoever was righteous among their fathers, their spouses and their offspring.
There is no deity except Him; to Him is the destination.

folded.id: this day|every|soul will be recompensed for what it earned
folded.subject: This Day
folded.object: soul will be recompensed for what it earned

spans.text: [17] AR: ٱلْيَوْمَ تُجْزَىٰ كُلُّ نَفْسٍۭ بِمَا كَسَبَتْ ۚ لَا ظُلْمَ ٱلْيَوْمَ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ سَرِيعُ ٱلْحِسَابِ EN: This Day every soul will be recompensed for what it earned.

folded.id: to gardens|of|perpetual residence which you have promised them and whoever was righteous among their fathers
folded.subject: to gardens
folded.object: perpetual residence which You have promised them and whoever was righteous among their fathers

spans.text: [8] AR: رَبَّنَا وَأَدْخِلْهُمْ جَنَّٰتِ عَدْنٍ ٱلَّتِى وَعَدتَّهُمْ وَمَن صَلَحَ مِنْ ءَابَآئِهِمْ وَأَزْوَٰجِهِمْ وَذُرِّيَّٰتِهِمْ ۚ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ EN: Our Lord, and admit them to gardens of perpetual residence which You have promised them and whoever was righteous among their fathers, their spouses and their offspring.
[14] AR: فَٱدْعُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ مُخْلِصِينَ لَهُ ٱلدِّينَ وَلَوْ كَرِهَ ٱلْكَٰفِرُونَ EN: So invoke Allah, [being] sincere to Him in religion, although the disbelievers dislike it.
There is no deity except Him; to Him is the destination.

[12] AR: ذَٰلِكُم بِأَنَّهُۥٓ إِذَا دُعِىَ ٱللَّهُ وَحْدَهُۥ كَفَرْتُمْ ۖ وَإِن يُشْرَكْ بِهِۦ تُؤْمِنُوا۟ ۚ فَٱلْحُكْمُ لِلَّهِ ٱلْعَلِىِّ ٱلْكَبِيرِ EN: [They will be told], "That is because, when Allah was called upon alone, you disbelieved; but if others were associated with Him, you believed.

[12] AR: ذَٰلِكُم بِأَنَّهُۥٓ إِذَا دُعِىَ ٱللَّهُ وَحْدَهُۥ كَفَرْتُمْ ۖ وَإِن يُشْرَكْ بِهِۦ تُؤْمِنُوا۟ ۚ فَٱلْحُكْمُ لِلَّهِ ٱلْعَلِىِّ ٱلْكَبِيرِ EN: [They will be told], "That is because, when Allah was called upon alone, you disbelieved; but if others were associated with Him, you believed.

folded.id: while those|they|invoke besides him judge not with anything
folded.subject: while those
folded.object: invoke besides Him judge not with anything

spans.text: [20] AR: وَٱللَّهُ يَقْضِى بِٱلْحَقِّ ۖ وَٱلَّذِينَ يَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِهِۦ لَا يَقْضُونَ بِشَىْءٍ ۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْبَصِيرُ EN: And Allah judges with truth, while those they invoke besides Him judge not with anything.

folded.id: will remember|except|he who turns back [in repentance]
folded.subject: will remember

spans.text: But none will remember except he who turns back [in repentance].
